statement: Producer fixed-case diagnostic: the six-variable Rust API qualification hits the unchanged 50000-term provenance cap during input rewrite (input 6), with 20 polynomial terms, polynomial degree 9 and 55976 proof terms. The qualifier reports this as a budget failure, not a complete solve or a speed result. This motivates testing removal of unused provenance in the polynomial-only containment check; final original-input membership checks must remain.
